citation.authors: Clark CM, Monahan KD, Drew RC
citation.title: Omega‑3 polyunsaturated fatty acid supplementation reduces blood pressure but not renal vasoconstrictor response to orthostatic stress in healthy older adults

population.description: Twenty healthy adults in two groups of 10: young 25 ± 1 y and older 66 ± 2 y (mean ± SEM, Results). Screened by history and examination: normotensive, nonsmokers, no cardiovascular or renal disease, no medication affecting autonomic or cardiovascular function (Methods). Sex per group from Table 1 row 'Number of subjects (men/women)': young 5 men / 5 women, older 3 men / 7 women. Age is given per group, so each protocol carries its group's age: SD = SEM x sqrt(10) computed (young 1 x 3.16; older 2 x 6.32). BMI not printed (height and weight are; BMI not derived). Only the pre-fish-oil visit is entered.

protocols.name: rest_pre_young
protocols.description: Young group (n = 10), pre-fish-oil visit (untreated): lying supine and instrumented for at least 30 min (the paper's lower bound, used as minutes 0 to 29), then the 3-min supine baseline before LBNP (minutes 30 to 32, the window). Fasted 8 h as the paper states (subjects were asked to refrain from ingesting food for 8 h before the visits); no meal. The visit clock hour is not printed; 08:00 assumed. Duration 33 min = 30 min run-in + 3 min baseline.

protocols.name: rest_pre_older
protocols.description: Older group (n = 10), pre-fish-oil visit (untreated): lying supine and instrumented for at least 30 min (the paper's lower bound, used as minutes 0 to 29), then the 3-min supine baseline before LBNP (minutes 30 to 32, the window). Fasted 8 h as the paper states (subjects were asked to refrain from ingesting food for 8 h before the visits); no meal. The visit clock hour is not printed; 08:00 assumed. Duration 33 min = 30 min run-in + 3 min baseline.
